name: Outside-In Agent Crawl Verification
summary: Verify a deployed public surface from outside the runtime using canonical URLs, machine endpoints, representative crawler user agents, payload-leak checks and provider indexing observations instead of trusting deployment success.
problem: CI and deployment commands can pass while public routing, DNS, canonical origins, crawler handling, static metadata or provider discovery are wrong.
requirements: Ability to make unauthenticated outside-in HTTP requests
boundaries: Sitemap submission does not prove crawl or index
Crawler user-agent acceptance does not prove provider ingestion
Synthetic checks do not prove every geographic edge
Do not perform unauthorised mutating probes
